method: Regularized logistic regression over16 amplitude-invariant channel-min/max features; equal source weight,50 source bootstraps, leave-one-whole-source-out review gates and labelled-noise support rejection.
admission: At least8 source groups and6 groups per class; no held-source programme review candidates; held-source noise coverage>=0.25. Candidate needs fifth-percentile bootstrap score>=0.95 and standardized nearest-noise support distance<=1.5.
uncertainty: Scores and bootstrap bounds are heuristic, not calibrated probabilities or semantic safe-noise guarantees.
finding: No advantage over classical baseline on32 simple fresh synthetic probes. Identical PCM used as desired noise effect and unwanted hiss gets the same review proposal; explicit diagnostic capture attenuates the desired effect9.593dB. No general automatic-capture adoption.
remaining: Adequate real grouped labels, independent source/level/rate/layout shifts and calibrated abstention

rust_inference.thread_contract: Model loading and direct evaluate allocate off the audio thread; native plugin worker handles inference asynchronously after explicit control-time configuration.

worker_integration_scope: Native Hiss API and generic factory configuration with retained hosted diagnostics; UI and live host application commands remain pending.

host_configuration.preparation: Explicit bounded single-read model loading; requested path/hash/setup/age persist; unavailable or unsupported inference keeps classical audio and publishes a reason
host_configuration.diagnostics: Stable ProfileSnapshot retains a read-only reader for final-callback results
host_configuration.reviewed_profile_preparation: Retained reader verifies the current review token and original PCM SHA256, measures a native profile off-thread, rechecks source identity, and returns profile/context/observation without changing the running processor. Caller explicitly reconstructs a preset to install it.
